title: Machine homeostasis must expose the system to its own consequences

statements.text: Earlier homeostatic machines were built from the outside in, told to keep arbitrary values in range, without the system itself being exposed to the consequences of its own activity. A homeostatic machine must be vulnerable to the world and so sensitive to its changes.

sources.quote: the homeostatic-like features of prior works were implemented from the outside-in
it was not made vulnerable to the world and therefore sensitive to changes in the world
